speaker: xerxes
text: According to law,
name: King Xerxes

speaker: xerxes
text: what should be done with Queen Vashti, since she refused to obey the command of King Xerxes delivered by the eunuchs?
name: King Xerxes

speaker: memucan
text: Queen Vashti has wronged not only the king, but all the princes and the peoples in all the provinces of King Xerxes.
name: Memucan

speaker: memucan
text: For the conduct of the queen will become known to all women, causing them to despise their husbands and say, ‘King Xerxes ordered Queen Vashti to be brought before him, but she did not come.’
name: Memucan

speaker: memucan
text: This very day the noble women of Persia and Media who have heard about the queen’s conduct will say the same thing to all the king’s officials, resulting in much contempt and wrath.
name: Memucan

speaker: memucan
text: So if it pleases the king, let him issue a royal decree, and let it be recorded in the laws of Persia and Media so that it cannot be repealed, that Vashti shall never again enter the presence of King Xerxes, and that her royal position shall be given to a woman better than she.
name: Memucan

speaker: memucan
text: The edict the king issues will be heard throughout his vast kingdom—and so all women, from the least to the greatest, will honor their husbands.
name: Memucan

speaker: attendants
text: Let a search be made for beautiful young virgins for the king,
name: The king's attendants

speaker: attendants
text: and let the king appoint commissioners in each province of his kingdom to assemble all the beautiful young women into the harem at the citadel of Susa. Let them be placed under the care of Hegai, the king’s eunuch in charge of the women, and let them be given beauty treatments.
name: The king's attendants

speaker: attendants
text: Then let the young woman who pleases the king become queen in place of Vashti.
name: The king's attendants

speaker: royal-servants
text: Why do you disobey the command of the king?
name: The royal servants

speaker: haman
text: There is a certain people scattered and dispersed among the peoples of every province of your kingdom. Their laws are different from everyone else’s, and they do not obey the king’s laws. So it is not in the king’s best interest to tolerate them.
name: Haman

speaker: haman
text: If it pleases the king, let a decree be issued to destroy them, and I will deposit ten thousand talents of silver into the royal treasury to pay those who carry it out.
name: Haman

speaker: xerxes
text: Keep your money,
name: King Xerxes

speaker: xerxes
text: These people are given to you to do with them as you please.
name: King Xerxes

speaker: esther
text: All the royal officials and the people of the king’s provinces know that one law applies to every man or woman who approaches the king in the inner court without being summoned—that he be put to death. Only if the king extends the gold scepter may that person live. But I have not been summoned to appear before the king for the past thirty days.
name: Esther

speaker: mordecai
text: Do not imagine that because you are in the king’s palace you alone will escape the fate of all the Jews.
name: Mordecai

speaker: mordecai
text: For if you remain silent at this time, relief and deliverance for the Jews will arise from another place, but you and your father’s house will perish. And who knows if perhaps you have come to the kingdom for such a time as this?
name: Mordecai

speaker: esther
text: Go and assemble all the Jews who can be found in Susa, and fast for me. Do not eat or drink for three days, night or day, and I and my maidens will fast as you do. After that, I will go to the king, even though it is against the law. And if I perish, I perish!
name: Esther

speaker: xerxes
text: What is it, Queen Esther?
name: King Xerxes

speaker: xerxes
text: What is your request? Even up to half the kingdom, it will be given to you.
name: King Xerxes

speaker: esther
text: If it pleases the king,
name: Esther

speaker: esther
text: may the king and Haman come today to the banquet I have prepared for the king.
name: Esther

speaker: xerxes
text: Hurry,
name: King Xerxes

speaker: xerxes
text: and bring Haman, so we can do as Esther has requested.
name: King Xerxes

speaker: xerxes
text: What is your petition? It will be given to you. What is your request? Even up to half the kingdom, it will be fulfilled.
name: King Xerxes

speaker: esther
text: This is my petition and my request:
name: Esther

speaker: esther
text: If I have found favor in the sight of the king, and if it pleases the king to grant my petition and fulfill my request, may the king and Haman come tomorrow to the banquet I will prepare for them. Then I will answer the king’s question.
name: Esther

speaker: haman
text: What is more,
name: Haman

speaker: haman
text: Queen Esther invited no one but me to join the king at the banquet she prepared, and I am invited back tomorrow along with the king.
name: Haman

speaker: haman
text: Yet none of this satisfies me as long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king’s gate.
name: Haman

speaker: zeresh
text: Have them build a gallows fifty cubits high, and ask the king in the morning to have Mordecai hanged on it. Then go to the banquet with the king and enjoy yourself.
name: Zeresh and Haman's friends

speaker: xerxes
text: What honor or dignity has been bestowed on Mordecai for this act?
name: King Xerxes

speaker: attendants
text: Nothing has been done for him,
name: The king's attendants

speaker: xerxes
text: Who is in the court?
name: King Xerxes

speaker: attendants
text: Haman is there, standing in the court.
name: The king's attendants

speaker: xerxes
text: Bring him in,
name: King Xerxes

speaker: xerxes
text: What should be done for the man whom the king is delighted to honor?
name: King Xerxes

speaker: haman
text: Whom would the king be delighted to honor more than me?
name: Haman

speaker: haman
text: For the man whom the king is delighted to honor,
name: Haman

speaker: haman
text: have them bring a royal robe that the king himself has worn and a horse on which the king himself has ridden—one with a royal crest placed on its head.
name: Haman

speaker: haman
text: Let the robe and the horse be entrusted to one of the king’s most noble princes. Let them array the man the king wants to honor and parade him on the horse through the city square, proclaiming before him, ‘This is what is done for the man whom the king is delighted to honor!’
name: Haman

speaker: xerxes
text: Hurry,
name: King Xerxes

speaker: xerxes
text: and do just as you proposed. Take the robe and the horse to Mordecai the Jew, who is sitting at the king’s gate. Do not neglect anything that you have suggested.
name: King Xerxes

speaker: haman
text: This is what is done for the man whom the king is delighted to honor!
name: Haman

speaker: zeresh
text: Since Mordecai, before whom your downfall has begun, is Jewish, you will not prevail against him—for surely you will fall before him.
name: Zeresh and Haman's friends

speaker: xerxes
text: Queen Esther, what is your petition? It will be given to you. What is your request? Even up to half the kingdom, it will be fulfilled.
name: King Xerxes

speaker: esther
text: If I have found favor in your sight, O king, and if it pleases the king, grant me my life as my petition, and the lives of my people as my request.
name: Esther

speaker: esther
text: For my people and I have been sold out to destruction, death, and annihilation. If we had merely been sold as menservants and maidservants, I would have remained silent, because no such distress would justify burdening the king.
name: Esther

speaker: xerxes
text: Who is this, and where is the one who would devise such a scheme?
name: King Xerxes

speaker: esther
text: The adversary and enemy is this wicked man—Haman!
name: Esther

speaker: xerxes
text: Would he actually assault the queen while I am in the palace?
name: King Xerxes

speaker: harbonah
text: There is a gallows fifty cubits high at Haman’s house. He had it built for Mordecai, who gave the report that saved the king.
name: Harbonah

speaker: xerxes
text: Hang him on it!
name: King Xerxes

speaker: esther
text: If it pleases the king,
name: Esther

speaker: esther
text: and if I have found favor in his sight, and the matter seems proper to the king, and I am pleasing in his sight, may an order be written to revoke the letters that the scheming Haman son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, wrote to destroy the Jews in all the king’s provinces.
name: Esther

speaker: esther
text: For how could I bear to see the disaster that would befall my people? How could I bear to see the destruction of my kindred?
name: Esther

speaker: xerxes
text: Behold, I have given Haman’s estate to Esther, and he was hanged on the gallows because he attacked the Jews.
name: King Xerxes

speaker: xerxes
text: Now you may write in the king’s name as you please regarding the Jews, and seal it with the royal signet ring. For a decree that is written in the name of the king and sealed with the royal signet ring cannot be revoked.
name: King Xerxes

speaker: xerxes
text: In the citadel of Susa the Jews have killed and destroyed five hundred men, including Haman’s ten sons. What have they done in the rest of the royal provinces? Now what is your petition? It will be given to you. And what further do you request? It will be fulfilled.
name: King Xerxes

speaker: esther
text: If it pleases the king, may the Jews in Susa also have tomorrow to carry out today’s edict, and may the bodies of Haman’s ten sons be hanged on the gallows.
name: Esther
